---
name: Bug report
about: Something renders wrong, errors out, or a widget shows an error frame
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**What happened?**
The visible symptom — paste the exact error text if a widget shows one.

**Where?**
- URL of the dashboard (a `?config=` link is ideal)
- Which widget(s)

**Browser and platform** (important — engine-specific bugs are real)
Chrome / Firefox / Safari, desktop or mobile, OS version.

**Console errors** (if you can open DevTools → Console)
Firefox/Safari CORS-style errors are especially useful — paste them even if
they look cryptic.

**Screenshots**
If it's visual.
